maria: Heads-up — acme-prod reported a P95 jump on /v1/generate at 10:12 UTC. Can someone point me to the fastest combo of dashboards/traces for TTFT + tokens/sec so I can hand this to SEs? :eyes:

alex: Quickest: Grafana 'TTFT & Tokenflow' dashboard (http://grafana.internal/d/abcdTTFT). Panels to look at: 'TTFT p50/p95/p99 by route', 'tokens/sec (route)', and 'TTFT decomposition — warm/cold/kv-cache'. Also open Jaeger link for traces: http://jaeger.internal/trace?service=inference-gateway&span=generate

jason: PromQL snippets I use for quick slices (1m resolution):
```
# tokens/sec by route
sum by(route) (rate(tokens_emitted_total[1m]))

# requests/sec by route
sum by(route) (rate(requests_total[1m]))

# avg TTFT (ms) by route (histogram_seconds is bucketed)
rate(ttft_bucket[1m]) -- then use histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(ttft_bucket[1m])) by (le, route))
```
These are rough; if you need per-model or seq-len slices add label selectors like `route="/v1/generate"` or `seq_len=">512"`.

oncall-bot: Alert triggered: p95-ttft-high (service=inference-gateway, route=/v1/generate) — alert fired at 2025-10-12T10:12:09Z. See incidents/ACME-231 on PagerDuty.

lee: If you're diagnosing, also check KV cache hit rate and batching breakdown. Two quick panels I look at: `kv_cache_hit_rate` (rolling 5m) and `tokens_per_request` histogram. A common pattern is a drop in cache hit + higher avg seq -> higher p95.

maria: Good call. Any quick trace samples to share? We need 3 examples (p50, p95, p99) to show to SEs.

jason: Dropped three jaeger trace links (short-lived):
- p50 sample: http://jaeger.internal/trace/abcd1234
- p95 sample: http://jaeger.internal/trace/efgh5678
- p99 sample: http://jaeger.internal/trace/ijkl9012

alex: Also: if you want tokens/sec by model variant/quantization: use `sum by(model_variant) (rate(tokens_emitted_total[1m]))`. If the p95 jump aligns with a rollout, route->model_variant will show it.

lee: For the alert tuning request: I suggest raising the p95 threshold from 900ms to 1100ms for the low-traffic canary tier and keep prod at 700ms. We can add a suppression window for 3m for planned rollouts. I'll open a PR against infra/alerts with rationale. :writing_hand:

maria: Perfect — can you also pin a short runbook snippet to the alert? Steps: 1) Check tokens/sec and kv_cache_hit_rate 2) Grab 3 traces 3) Validate recent rollouts 4) cherry-pick fallback model if needed.

alex: Will do. I'll add the runbook and a Grafana link to the alert, and create a dashboard bookmark with the 3 panels (TTFT, tokens/sec, kv_cache_hit_rate). ETA ~30m. :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks all — passing this to SEs now. If the PR changes threshold, ping me and I'll update the customer note.
